name: Royal Palm Beach
dining_districts: the Royal Palm Beach Boulevard plazas
intro: Royal Palm Beach anchors the western communities' everyday dining — family restaurants, diners, Latin and Caribbean kitchens, and pizzerias spread along Southern and Okeechobee Boulevards, feeding a fast-growing residential village that eats out close to home. Community events at the Commons and a busy catering trade add weekend volume.

Western-communities kitchens used to accept second-tier delivery service as the price of the address; they shouldn't. Our Palm Beach route runs the village daily — about fifty minutes out of Pompano Beach — with the same no-fee, no-minimum terms as the coast, the same midnight cutoff, and the same refrigerated trucks.
route_note: About 50 minutes from our Pompano Beach warehouse on the western Palm Beach leg — village stops land before lunch prep, seven days a week.

faqs_unique.q: Do you charge extra to deliver to the western communities?
faqs_unique.a: No. Royal Palm Beach rides the standard Palm Beach route — no delivery fees, no fuel charges, no minimums, same as coastal kitchens.

faqs_unique.q: Can caterers in Royal Palm Beach get event-volume flexibility?
faqs_unique.a: Yes. Hold a standing baseline and layer event volume on by the midnight cutoff — weekend community events are routine adds on this route.

cta_text: Tell us your family kitchen's staples or your catering calendar — we will bring coast-grade produce service to Royal Palm Beach daily.
